Title: PDM Design and Development:
Description: Partnered with Busscar Official to design and develop a Product Data Management (PDM) system aimed at enhancing control over the company's blueprint documents, ensuring quality and security compliance. Leveraged .NET framework and ASP.NET Core technologies to create a user-friendly and secure platform for managing and storing critical design documents. Demonstrated proficiency in web application development, contributing to the creation of a centralized repository for storing and accessing blueprint documents, thereby improving collaboration and efficiency across departments.

Title: Platform Picking System Development
Description: Collaborated with Busscar Official to develop a platform that seamlessly integrates with the company's ERP system, facilitating the loading of required materials for each Production Order and streamlining the material separation process. Implemented Agile methodologies to ensure efficient project management and timely delivery of project milestones. Utilized ASP.NET Core for the development of the platform, ensuring robustness, scalability, and security. Demonstrated expertise in software development, contributing to the design and implementation of a solution that meets the specific needs of the organization.

Title: Database Migration to Azure
Description: Led and supported the migration of an on-premise database to the Azure cloud for several critical applications within the company, totaling approximately 6 terabytes of data. Implemented Agile methodologies to manage the migration project efficiently and minimize downtime. Leveraged Microsoft Azure services to establish a scalable and secure environment for hosting the migrated database. Demonstrated expertise in software quality assurance, ensuring data integrity and consistency throughout the migration process, resulting in a successful and seamless transition to the cloud.

Title: Standardization of Test Automation
Description: Collaborated with GMSTEK, LLC on the "Standardization of Test Automation" project, aimed at establishing a robust framework and guidelines for test automation within the company. Played a key role in defining a structured approach to test automation, promoting consistency and efficiency across testing processes. Utilized Java and Selenium for test automation, ensuring thorough testing coverage and reliable test results. Demonstrated leadership skills in driving the initiative forward, resulting in improved quality assurance processes and enhanced product quality.
